newsitem.title: USA: Vistana names finance, operating chiefs.
newsitem.headline: Vistana names finance, operating chiefs.

text.p: Vistana Inc, a vacation resorts operator, said Wednesday it named John Sabin, 42, as senior vice president, chief financial officer and treasurer.
Sabin was former vice president for finance of Choice Hotels International Inc. Before that, he was vice president for mergers and acquisitions at Marriott Corp.
Sabin replaces Matthew Avril, 36, as chief financial officer.
Avril was named executive vice president and chief operating officer, the company said.
